import base64, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import run

        'result,service,attempt,payload')
L1={'id':'L1','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],
    'low_count':2}
SVCS=[{'id':'adb','kind':'adb'},{'id':'sync','kind':'sync'},{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}]
N1='2001:db8:1:1200::'
CAN='2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd'

def campaign(rows,leases=(L1,),queries=(10,),services=SVCS):
    data='\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n'
    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':list(leases),
            'services':services,'queries':list(queries),
            'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()]}],
            'requests':[],'offers':[],
            'request_quotas':[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':9}],
            'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':9}]}

    snaps=out['snapshots']
    if at is None: snap=snaps[0]
    else: snap=[s for s in snaps if s['at']==at][0]
    for entry in snap['leases']:
        if entry['lease']==name: return entry
    raise KeyError(name)

def svc(entry,name):
    for row in entry['services']:
        if row['id']==name: return row
    raise KeyError(name)

      f'icmp,b,0,5,put,L1,2,0/i1,{N1}1,{N1}9,echo,,,',
      f'icmp,c,0,5,put,L1,3,0/i2,{N1}2,{N1}2,error,,,']

    return struct.pack('<6I',command,arg0,arg1,len(body),
